payload.agentOutputExcerpt: Implemented RECALL-3: grouped accessible recall results, board check/missed/extra/type-mismatch markers, live announcements, keyboard focus, reduced-motion handling, and no-persistence evidence. Required unit and Playwright validations pass.
decisions: The summary is the accessible source of truth; the board overlay is decorative and aria-hidden.
The live region stays mounted for the page lifetime so Check is a real announcement update.
Check moves focus to the results heading while leaving all toolbar actions mounted.
Overlay placement uses the same plain card positions and camera as the canvas, without importing PixiJS.
agentReportedTests: npm run test:e2e -- e2e/recall-results.spec.ts: exit 0 (desktop + tablet; phone skipped intentionally)
warnings: Lint reports three nonblocking react-refresh advisories because RecallSummary also exports pure label/announcement helpers.
The phone Playwright project skips the pointer scratch-drawing journey; keyboard entry/check/reset/exit are covered by component tests.
payload.taskDescription: Create RecallResults and RecallSummary. On Check, compute comparison results and overlay markers on the board: remembered check, missed dashed outline, extra muted cross, and a type-mismatch label. Render a grouped summary list of remembered, missed, extra, and type-mismatched pairs with card titles and counts inside RecallPage. Announce the summary with aria-live and keep it fully keyboard readable. Respect reduced motion and ensure no score wording. Add component tests for all groups, type mismatch, empty scratch, and keyboard reading; extend the Playwright recall journey to assert visible results and no persistence.
